description:
Perform a parametric study on the effect of camber on aerodynamic efficiency. 

1. Open QBlade and use the NACA Airfoil Generator to create four airfoils with 15% thickness and varying camber: NACA 0015, NACA 2415, NACA 4415, and NACA 6415.

2. Perform an XFOIL Direct Analysis on EACH airfoil with these settings:
   - Reynolds Number: 500,000
   - Ncrit: 9
   - Alpha Range: -5 to 20 degrees (Step 0.5)

3. Determine the Maximum Lift-to-Drag Ratio (L/D_max) for each airfoil.

4. Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/camber_study_report.txt' listing the results. Format:
   NACA 0015: L/D_max = [value], at alpha = [value] deg
   NACA 2415: L/D_max = [value], at alpha = [value] deg
   NACA 4415: L/D_max = [value], at alpha = [value] deg
   NACA 6415: L/D_max = [value], at alpha = [value] deg
   BEST AIRFOIL: NACA [XXXX]

5. Save the QBlade project containing all airfoils and polars to '/home/ga/Documents/projects/camber_study.wpa'.
